title: Native lower-bound semantics incorrect
reproduction: Construct SafetySpec with BoxConstraint.lower containing a negative entry (schema-legal).
Build CVXPY constraints (x >= lower) vs native build_moreau_standard_form.
Observe native unconditional x_i >= 0 and missing lower row when lower_i <= 0.
expected_behavior: Native cone rows encode each finite declared lower bound (x_i >= lower_i), matching CVXPY; no stronger implicit nonnegativity unless required by the constraint family.
current_behavior: native_moreau_builder always adds -x_i <= 0 and only adds an extra lower row when lower_i > 1e-15.

title: Solver output released without independent admissibility verification
reproduction: Native: project() assigns corrected_action from solution.x with no residual/finite gate.
CVXPY: only checks x.value is not None; no inaccurate/timeout/iteration-limit release policy.
expected_behavior: Backend-independent verifier gates release on finite values, residuals, and declared status policy.
current_behavior: Native returns solution.x; CVXPY returns x.value when present.

title: Vendor CI false confidence via skips
reproduction: Run vendor-marked tests without license: many tests pytest.skip.
solver-ci.yml does not set CONICSHIELD_VENDOR_REQUIRED=1.
expected_behavior: Under CONICSHIELD_VENDOR_REQUIRED=1, license/capability skips are hard failures; vendor CI sets the flag and post-checks executed solves.
current_behavior: Skips are allowed; shared required-mode helper exists only as S0 scaffolding under tests/stabilization/.

title: Warm-start state not isolated across episodes
reproduction: InterSimConicShield.choose_action populates _projector_cache; native projector stores _warm.
reset_episode() only clears _previous_distribution.
expected_behavior: reset_episode clears previous action and episode/projector warm-start (or equivalent reset_state protocol) so first-solve matches a fresh projector.
current_behavior: Cached projectors and persist_warm_start state survive reset_episode.

title: Invalid objective weights silently coerced
reproduction: objective_pq(..., reference_weight=-1) clips rw to 0.
objective_pq(..., policy_weight=0, reference_weight=0) replaces scale with 1e-12.
expected_behavior: Finite policy_weight >= 0, reference_weight >= 0, and strictly positive sum; otherwise raise a typed error.
current_behavior: Silent coercion alters the declared objective.

title: Public vs vendor backend boundaries unclear
reproduction: Backend enum exposes only CVXPY_MOREAU / NATIVE_MOREAU / NATIVE_MOREAU_BATCH.
Default create_projector uses CVXPY_MOREAU which still requires vendor Moreau registration.
Docs describe public/reference operation without credentials.
expected_behavior: Explicit AUTO/PUBLIC_CLARABEL/PUBLIC_SCS members; AUTO never selects vendor Moreau merely because it imports.
current_behavior: No AUTO/public backends; default is CVXPY_MOREAU with unclear public/vendor boundary.

title: Verification commands may mutate repository state
reproduction: make verify-reference-system depends on sync-community-metadata.
scripts/sync_community_metadata.py writes COMMUNITY_METADATA.json with no --check mode.
expected_behavior: verify-*/check-* targets are read-only; sync/generate/refresh support --check; CI fails on dirty worktree after verify.

title: Batch semantics artificially restricted (shared P/A/b only)
reproduction: NativeMoreauCompiledBatchProjector.project_batch uses one previous_action and shared A/b numeric values across rows.
expected_behavior: Heterogeneous batch API with per-row previous/reference/weights under shared structural topology.
current_behavior: Only q varies across rows; shared previous/reference configuration.

title: Batch compilation discarded by InterSim adapter
reproduction: project_softmax_batch calls create_batch_projector on every invocation.
expected_behavior: Bounded batch-projector cache keyed by structural fingerprint with reuse telemetry.

title: Cache keys mix structure with runtime values
reproduction: _spec_cache_key hashes full SafetySpec.model_dump() including numeric bounds/rates.
expected_behavior: Separate structural fingerprint from numerical parameters and trajectory state; bounded LRU.
current_behavior: Full JSON hash; unbounded dict cache.

title: Sparse problem construction repeated unnecessarily
reproduction: Each project rebuilds dense rows, stacks, converts to CSR; CompiledSolver.setup each solve.
expected_behavior: Fixed-structure CompiledShieldTemplate with parameter fills; skip setup when values fingerprint unchanged.

title: Batch telemetry incomplete
reproduction: Sequential compiled path reduces batched metadata to first row; batch path returns only ndarray.
expected_behavior: BatchProjectionResult with per-row ProjectionResult and batch-level timing/cache fields.

title: Active constraints inaccurately reported
reproduction: active_constraints appends turn_feasibility whenever any action is prohibited, ignoring solution residuals.
expected_behavior: Active set from verified residuals and active_tol with stable identifiers.

title: Status normalization is heuristic
reproduction: Telemetry/tests treat values like '1'/'true'/'ok' as success-like.
expected_behavior: Backend-specific adapters to a canonical status enum; unknown -> UNKNOWN not success.

title: Concurrency behavior undefined
reproduction: Cached projectors hold mutable warm-start/compiled solver state with no declared concurrency model.
expected_behavior: Declared model (instance-confined, lock-protected, or pooled exclusive checkout) with tests.
current_behavior: Undefined concurrent use of mutable projectors.

title: Installation profiles overly coupled
reproduction: optional-dependencies.solver installs moreau[cuda]; vendor CI pins Python 3.11.
expected_behavior: Split solver-public / moreau-cpu / moreau-cuda / diff-* extras with markers.

title: Moreau provenance not sufficiently established
reproduction: Bootstrap/docs assume particular package source and license arrangement without a solver-doctor evidence command.
expected_behavior: conicshield solver-doctor --json recording install provenance, devices, license check, commit, settings.
current_behavior: Partial probes via environment_check / bootstrap assumptions.

title: Windows documented as workaround, not qualified operating mode
reproduction: Bootstrap hard-fails outside Linux; public CI is Ubuntu-only; docs push WSL2 for Moreau.
expected_behavior: Qualify distinct Windows public/vendor modes with CI evidence.
current_behavior: Windows treated as workaround; S0 captures Windows public-mode status in baseline artifacts.
